title: Routine-day proof, pending commission, narrated payments and watched ritual boundaries

reviews.classification: historical content/persistence proof; unperformed economy and ability consumers retained
reviews.disposition: Seventeen acts include thirteen deep acts and four routine-day cards, not seventeen independently deep mechanics. The receipt's fully read text range ends at ch41P030; P031–P066 is excluded lead-invisible content, so its nominal scope does not prove those pages were fully source-read. The 655-minute night and two1440-minute cards passed across day boundaries, including10080; that is this pack/B10 behavior, not general civil-clock or unattended aging proof. Constraint-store select was not run. The proof comprises a saved fourteen-act prefix, two browser closures during Wednesday, an isolated Wednesday pass and a resumed final three acts/persistence. Browser lifetime is the author's plausible diagnosis, not a demonstrated universal25-minute limit or proof of game immunity. Night does not recover the pool; separate Cogitation does, with0/3→3/0 and zero later vision use. Dowsing is Neil's watched demonstration, not Klein's method execution. The signed application is pending with unstated subject/amount, and a permitted/inferred pendulum is not item custody. B12 was filed as proposed, whereas M1–M8 were not implemented. Routine notes do not perform the proposed period-line consumer. Money798 remains a ceiling and the seven-pence ration belongs to the next window. Existing actor visits, literal import/reload and exact facts are bounded historical proof; no full suite, new source build, typography or civil-clock test ran.

reviews.classification: historical content/persistence proof; unperformed economy and ability consumers retained
reviews.disposition: Twenty-five acts retain the two-scene apartment/company window and288 labelled fill minutes. The ten-pound2400pence commission share is earned/pending in prose, not received: no signing, no share.collected, no native credit, money787. Neil's debt, wages, market/material access and tax bands are knowledge lines, not economy consumers. The following membership1200pence cannot be funded by787 without a real source transfer or an explicit narration fallback. Watch-only ritual/portrait and fixed-outcome failed dowsing do not supply ability execution or measured costs; no Seer use/recovery occurs and pool1/2 stays stable. Frye/police/neighbours remain text roles. Holder evidence has two stores: the world container/holder and rounds5 were checked; desk in the actor ledger is reported only from the brief and was not independently re-found here. Preserve this uncertainty rather than reconciling stores by assertion. A219-minute noon act inside day9 passed with zero selected beats/anchors on day8+, which does not repair all reserved-beat long-act cases. The597.1-second native/persistence run is frozen B10 evidence without new build/full suite/font/civil-clock checks. M1–M7 are proposed backlog texts, explicitly not filed.

reviews.classification: historical content/persistence proof; unperformed economy and ability consumers retained
reviews.disposition: The club/dinner window contains no remote gathering; closed seats/aliases are guards rather than new session use. Twenty-five acts preserve461 fill minutes and bounded native persistence. The economic fallback remains substantive: fee.paid.shown and note.given.benson describe two five-pound transfers from an unshown share while native money stays787, share.collected is absent and the predecessor's pending flag remains true. The equation787+2400−1200−1200=787 explains the final net only; it does not prove funded intermediate cash flow, commission settlement, membership payment, gift custody or a closed pending claim. Keep those exact B13/B6/B12 consumers open. Cufflinks/member registration and listed price2→8pence/eighth commission are facts/knowledge, not held goods or a functioning client market. One aura use reaches0/3 without implementing vision switching/exhaustion. Teachers/attendant/client remain text roles. Actual sibling relocation/visit repairs ambiguous presence and limits table-talk knowledge; the dinner's Moretti-flat choice is this pack resolution, not a proven universal place alias. Two long acts181/130 inside day9 passed with no later reserved beats, a bounded B9 datapoint. The665.1-second journey and literal import/reload do not establish typography/full-suite/new-build/civil-clock proof. All seven backlog texts remain unfiled proposals, and the next checkpoint's stated note holder is narrative fact rather than a native money/item transfer.

reviews.classification: historical content/persistence proof; unperformed economy and ability consumers retained
reviews.disposition: Twenty-five acts include1037 labelled fill minutes and a695-minute night across day9→10, with no selected beats/anchors on those days. That passes this B10 long-act case, not a general B9/civil-clock repair. The lead watches another actor's ritual and Spirit Vision tap; no player ability is acquired, no energy is spent/recovered and pool0/3 stays unchanged even through the night. Burnt IOU, claimed settlement and found wallet are distinct facts: no debt settlement, wallet custody, native money transfer or causal link from ritual to wallet is established. The source's “over300 pounds” and the receipt's72000–84000pence table must not be treated as a source-proven upper bound or exact counted amount without qualification. Share pending and money787 remain unchanged. Neil's view of the find is testimony, not validated mechanism. Household calls, dress/savings and offstage roles likewise remain knowledge. All25acts passed in the first run, but final post-import boot timed out; a zero-act saved-checkpoint resume supplied persistence proof. Machine load is the author's attribution, not a reproduced diagnosis, and the two parts cannot be reported as one uninterrupted complete run. Optional-chain runner repair and presence visits are separate from gameplay mechanisms. The1613.6-second act run plus resumed import/reload prove a bounded historical slice, without new build/full suite/fonts/civil clock. M1–M6 are explicitly proposed and not filed. Its final street prose and company-place native checkpoint remain different representations until a place consumer establishes the intended mapping.
